title: Real Madrid dismiss Trent Alexander-Arnold exit speculation as transfer window nears close
content: Real Madrid have firmly dismissed speculation surrounding the immediate future of Trent Alexander-Arnold as the transfer window draws to a close. Despite swirling rumours of a shock return to Liverpool, club sources indicate that the full-back is not for sale. The England international joined Real Madrid from Liverpool earlier this year on a highly anticipated move, and the Spanish giants consider him an important part of their squad going forward. Reports linking him with a stunning return to Anfield before the transfer deadline have been described by sources close to the club as wide of the mark.
